pages.text: $(thing)Guide Shelf$() puts buttons in your inventory screen for every Patchouli book and other in-game guide. This Field Guide is a Patchouli book, so it is listed there too.

pages.title: Guide Shelf
pages.text: Open a guide without holding the book. Handy for mods that ship their own handbook.

You also get this book on first join, and can craft it from a Book and Andesite (shapeless). JEI can open it too.$(br2)Mods like Create keep help in Ponder: hold $(bold)W$() over an item.$(br2)Start: $(l:start_here/welcome)Welcome$(/l).
